name: successor-chain-v1
idea: Join the existing baseline chains into successor traces, preferring the original conditional false arm, with baseline node-number seed priority and strict predicted-jump improvement guard.
expected_effect: More branch successors adjacent; fewer checked Linear Lgoto instructions. Equal/worse predicted jump costs retain baseline layout.
verification_boundary: Original enumerate checker and all semantic proofs unchanged. Cost model is an optimization heuristic, not a validator.
holdout_policy: No MiBench layout metrics inspected; frozen support discovery only.
result: Correct, but no structural improvement on any of 19 development workloads.
reason: Entry-first greedy traces did not beat the already useful baseline adjacencies under the strict jump-cost guard; all retained orders yield identical jump and text-size metrics.
